en.heading: 14 August: the Commission on the Filipino Language was created in 1991
en.origin: The Komisyon sa Wikang Filipino is a public institution devoted to the development, preservation and promotion of Filipino and the country's other languages, recognizing the linguistic diversity of communities. Republic Act No. 7104, approved 14 August 1991, established the Commission and defined its responsibilities for linguistic research, enrichment and public information. The law was enacted in 1991, not 1981 as printed in an NCCA calendar label. Executive Order No. 158 of 1999 later returned the Commission to the administrative supervision of the President's Office. This management change is not the founding of a second language commission.

en.heading: 31 May: National Fisherfolks Day began with coastal communities
en.origin: National Fisherfolks Day recognizes small-scale fishing families and the contributions of coastal and inland fishing communities to food supply, livelihoods and stewardship of marine resources. At a conference held from 26 to 28 May 1999, leaders of coastal local governments supported a resolution calling for a national day. The fisherfolks sector itself also petitioned the President through the National Anti-Poverty Commission. Proclamation No. 261 signed 3 April 2000 established 31 May annually and named the fisheries bureau and the fisherfolks council as lead agencies, with support from local governments and educational institutions.

en.heading: 17 March: Ramon Magsaysay Memorial Day also has a weekend rule
en.origin: Ramon Magsaysay Memorial Day commemorates the Philippine President who died on 17 March 1957 in an aircraft crash. A separate one-month national mourning period was proclaimed immediately after his death. Proclamation No. 15, signed 7 March 1966, created an annual 17 March memorial with half-mast flags, military salutes and short remembrance ceremonies in schools and public offices. Memorandum Circular No. 165 of 12 March 1968 directed schools and government offices to hold their ceremonies on the preceding school or business day when 17 March falls on a Saturday or Sunday. The anniversary date itself remains 17 March.

en.heading: 6–12 June: Linggo ng Kalayaan is a week, not a single holiday
en.origin: Linggo ng Kalayaan, or Independence Week, brings together civic projects, cultural activities and historical reflection in the week leading to Philippine Independence Day on 12 June. Proclamation No. 914, signed by President Corazon Aquino on 1 June 1992, declared 6–12 June every year Linggo ng Kalayaan and invited government and society to celebrate freedom and democratic heritage. The proclamation referred to the ninety-fourth independence anniversary and the centennial celebrations of the Katipunan and La Liga Filipina. The entire week is not a seven-day statutory non-working holiday; June 12 has its own separate national legal origin.

en.purpose: Celebrate Independence Week while keeping its 6–12 June dates separate from the June 12 national holiday.
facts: Linggo ng Kalayaan, or Independence Week, brings together civic projects, cultural activities and historical reflection in the week leading to Philippine Independence Day on 12 June.

Proclamation No. 914, signed by President Corazon Aquino on 1 June 1992, declared 6–12 June every year Linggo ng Kalayaan and invited government and society to celebrate freedom and democratic heritage.

The proclamation referred to the ninety-fourth independence anniversary and the centennial celebrations of the Katipunan and La Liga Filipina. The entire week is not a seven-day statutory non-working holiday; June 12 has its own separate national legal origin.

it.heading: 6–12 giugno: Linggo ng Kalayaan è una settimana, non un giorno
it.origin: Linggo ng Kalayaan, la Settimana dell'indipendenza, riunisce iniziative civiche, attività culturali e riflessione storica nella settimana che precede il 12 giugno. La Proclamazione n. 914, firmata da Corazon Aquino il 1º giugno 1992, istituì il periodo 6–12 giugno ogni anno e invitò istituzioni e cittadini a celebrare libertà e democrazia. La proclamazione ricordava il 94º anniversario dell'indipendenza e i centenari di Katipunan e La Liga Filipina. La settimana non consiste in sette giorni non lavorativi: il 12 giugno ha norme proprie.

fr.heading: 6–12 juin : Linggo ng Kalayaan dure une semaine
fr.origin: Linggo ng Kalayaan, la Semaine de l'indépendance, rassemble projets citoyens, activités culturelles et réflexion historique avant le 12 juin. La proclamation nº 914, signée par Corazon Aquino le 1er juin 1992, a institué chaque année du 6 au 12 juin pour valoriser liberté et héritage démocratique. Le texte évoquait le 94e anniversaire de l'indépendance et les centenaires de Katipunan et La Liga Filipina. La semaine ne crée pas sept jours fériés; le 12 juin relève d'un autre texte.
